changelog: **Every Alliance class now has a guide.** Priest, Paladin, Warrior and Rogue join Druid, Mage, Warlock, Hunter and Shaman. Each has roles, stat priorities, upgrade scoring, class milestones, and trainer spells 1-60 from 60.tools Forever data with "What it does" text. Forever-only spells (Priest Starshards and Hex of Weakness, Paladin Holy Strike and Voice of Truth, Warrior Victory Rush) are included. **Gear rules:** plate unlocks at 40 for Paladins and Warriors, Warriors dual wield from 20, and Rogues from level 1.
